fpga_derived_clock_invalid.en: The multiplier and divider must fit the Series 7 MMCM and global clock buffer operating limits.
fpga_derived_clock_invalid.pt: O multiplicador e o divisor devem respeitar os limites do MMCM Series 7 e do buffer global de clock.

fpga_derived_clock_inverted.en: A derived clock requires a non-inverted board oscillator signal.
fpga_derived_clock_inverted.pt: Um clock derivado requer o sinal do oscilador da placa sem inversão.

fpga_derived_clock_unsupported.en: Derived clocks require a Xilinx Series 7 board and the Vivado flow.
fpga_derived_clock_unsupported.pt: Clocks derivados exigem uma placa Xilinx Series 7 e o fluxo Vivado.
